description: Extensions to existing users collection for branch assignment support

assignedBranch.description: Branch ID for branch-scoped roles (receptionist, projectadmin)
assignedBranch.validation: Must be valid branch document ID

assignedBy.description: User ID who made the assignment

unassignedAt.description: When the assignment was removed (null if current)

canViewAllInquiries.description: Can view all inquiries in assigned branch

role.description: Added receptionist role to existing enum

department.note: ONLY for operations users - operations are department-scoped, NOT branch-scoped

branchScoped.description: These roles are tied to specific branches, NOT departments

departmentScoped.description: Operations users are tied to departments, NOT branches

globalScoped.description: These roles operate across organizational boundaries

rules: assignedBranch is REQUIRED for receptionist and projectadmin roles ONLY
assignedBranch must be NULL for ALL other roles (operations, director, consultant, etc.)
department is REQUIRED for operations role ONLY
department must be NULL for receptionist and projectadmin roles
assignedBranch and department are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE - a user cannot have both
assignedBranch must reference valid branch document
branchAssignmentHistory must be updated whenever assignedBranch changes

existingUsers.projectadmin: Assign to default branch or require manual assignment
